bash: cd /app/polyglot && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, random
def mat(n):                 # third method: matrix power by exponentiation
    def mul(A,B):
        return [[A[0][0]*B[0][0]+A[0][1]*B[1][0], A[0][0]*B[0][1]+A[0][1]*B[1][1]],
                [A[1][0]*B[0][0]+A[1][1]*B[1][0], A[1][0]*B[0][1]+A[1][1]*B[1][1]]]
    R=[[1,0],[0,1]]; M=[[1,1],[1,0]]
    while n:
        if n&1: R=mul(R,M)
        M=mul(M,M); n>>=1
    return R[0][1]
random.seed(7)
ns=[0,1,2,3]+[random.randrange(0,5000) for _ in range(40)]+[999,1000,4096,5000]
bad=0
for n in ns:
    want=str(mat(n))
    py=subprocess.run(["python3","main.py.c",str(n)],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
    c=subprocess.run(["./cmain",str(n)],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
    if py!=want or c!=want:
        bad+=1; print("BAD n=",n, "py_ok" if py==want else "py_bad", "c_ok" if c==want else "c_bad")
print(f"matrix-power cross-check over {len(ns)} values:", "ALL OK" if bad==0 else f"{bad} FAILURES")
EOF
